title: PARK FPS BOOSTER
features:
You can remove anything from this script you would like to keep in your game.

This script removes Background scenery and other things in the game to make your fps 100 more smoother "It also looks WAYYY better then the TRASH low proformance mode they have currently"



-- day 1 grind back to verifyed.
script:
print ("ENJOY THIS SMOOTH HOOPS LIFE FPS!")

game.Workspace.BackgroundScenery:Destroy()

wait(0.2)

game.Workspace.Building:Destroy()

wait(0.2)

game.Workspace.Nature:Destroy()

wait(0.2)
game.Workspace.Concrete:Destroy()

wait(0.2)
game.Workspace.SmallScenery:Destroy()


wait(0.2)

game.Workspace.Roads:Destroy()

wait(0.2)

game.Workspace.LED:Destroy()
